newsitem.title: UK: Sun Life says current trade "encouraging".
newsitem.headline: Sun Life says current trade "encouraging".

text.p: British insurer Sun Life and Provincial Holdings Plc said on Tuesday that its trading in the current year had so far been encouraging.
"I am pleased to report that trading so far this year has been encouraging in each of the three main operating companies," Lord Douro, the group chairman told shareholders at its annual meeting.
Douro said that volume and value of the group's new business were ahead of that achieved in the same period of 1996.
"The new group money purchase plan introduced in January has been particularly well received," he added.
The group's premium income from its Irish life and pension business, New Ireland Assurance, was "comfortably ahead" of last year, he said.
Douro said its UAP Provincial business had also performed well and had showed good underwriting results in the first quarter.
